title: La Manita — Fixed Price Mix-and-Match Postulate

core.statement: La Manita is a fixed-price bundle system in which the customer selects exactly one product from each of five product families, receiving five items for a fixed total price of EUR 5.00.

economic_postulates.rule: Customer-facing total remains fixed at EUR 5.00 for every valid combination.
All listed references should remain freely combinable across families whenever economically possible.
Economic validity is evaluated at bundle level, not product level only.
The most expensive valid combination must remain within the configured maximum bundle cost.
Cost, sourcing, dietary, stock, conservation, traceability and supplier complexity remain invisible to the customer.
La Manita never duplicates product master data; it references canonical product records.
Each product inherits MAKE, BUY, HYBRID or UNDECIDED sourcing logic from the Make_or_Buy doctrine.
A family should contain a portfolio of economic roles, not only the cheapest products.
The engine may favor at least one signature product per bundle when compatible with price and availability.
Dynamic references such as Dessert du jour may resolve to eligible canonical products without altering family structure.
FULL_MATRIX eligibility is controlled by family cost envelopes. Over-budget references remain in the canonical catalog but are excluded from La Manita 5.
Adding a reference cannot reduce the family maximum; therefore assortment density is subordinate to FULL_MATRIX economic validity.

FULL_MATRIX admission is evaluated on the expected bundle cost under the observed choice distribution. worst_case_bundle_cost remains computed as an exposure measure, not as the sole admission gate. An absolute per-item cap remains in force so that no over-budget reference is admitted by dilution into an average.

A Manita reference is a serving unit, not necessarily the shop SKU. It may be the canonical product as-is, a portion of it, or a transformation of surplus. Its effective cost is derived from the canonical product by an explicit rule, never re-entered by hand.

La Manita may operate as a traffic compartment whose margin is completed by attached full-margin purchases. Attachment may only offset bundle cost once attach rate and attach margin are measured; until then the bundle stands on its own economics.

dietary_logic.completion_rule: A dietary bundle is valid only if one eligible product exists in every required family.
dietary_logic.failure_rule: If a complete bundle cannot be formed, return NO_VALID_BUNDLE and identify the blocking family.
